description: Whatever is sent, more is needed, because prices move and the needs are medical. There is no amount that discharges it and no point at which the sender is finished.
energy_note: A bill that is never paid in full.

aspect: It delays the sender's own life by a decade
description: Deposit, pension, training, children - deferred to fund a household on another continent. Measured at sixty, the remittance decade is not recoverable.
energy_note: Your thirties, spent on somebody else's survival.

aspect: And returning without visible success is not an option
description: A return with nothing to show is read as failure by an extended family that may have funded the departure, which is why people stay abroad in conditions they would not accept at home.
energy_note: Staying away, because coming back would have to be explained.

aspect: The one who stayed carries the actual work
description: Hospital visits, funerals, property, the ageing parent. Money is sent; presence is not, and the sibling who stayed knows precisely which of the two is harder.
energy_note: He sends money. She sits with their mother.

aspect: Neither can say any of this out loud
description: The sender cannot complain about the cost without sounding ungenerous; the receiver cannot complain about the absence without sounding ungrateful. Both learn to talk around it, permanently.
energy_note: A subject the whole family talks around.

description: Every December someone asks when he is coming home. He has not been in four years. The airfare is real but it is not the reason, and he cannot explain the actual reason without describing a life that sounds like failure.
energy_note: Four years, and an answer he cannot give.
